No final-review obligation is declared: this is a behavior-preserving move whose evidence is the unmodified opencode suite, check, build, and pack:check through the barrel.

GRACE lifecycle commands are external execution gates, never nested MustPassCommand values. The test ! -f leaf command is file-shape evidence for the removed interim directory barrel, not a lifecycle command.
